periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis of patches exhibits a downward inward tilt of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal midline
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a vertical length approximately twice the horizontal width
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward elongation with the lowest point of the patch tapering toward the muzzle area

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thickness at the lateral flanks occupies approximately 35-40% of the visible vertical torso height

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Ears are widely set at the lateral-superior boundaries of the cranium with a large inter-pinna gap
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and rounded with a slight flattening visible at the topmost curvature

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-tan discoloration of the fur on the lower abdominal region and hind limbs in contrast to the white cranial fur
